newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet fuel firm on strong demand, Med weak.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet fuel firm on strong demand, Med weak.

text.p: Healthy demand supported NWE jet fuel premiums at unchanged levels on Wednesday, traders said.
Jan IPE gas oil ended up 75 cents at $230.25 a tonne and Feb IPE ended down 25 cents at $226 after NYMEX products recovered opening losses on cold European weather.
A cargo of jet kerosene traded at cif high quotes flat into Immingham. Traders said cargoes were tight for prompt material.
Barges remained around Jan +$28 fob ARA and traders reported good demand. The Med was full of product, the result of the closure of the arb to Asia. Premiums were fob Med high +$4/5.
